_readme: Topic pages over data/professors.json. Each gathers the faculty who list that topic among their
The rule that keeps these honest: a professor appears on a topic page only because a phrase they
wrote on their own faculty or lab page matched, and the page shows that phrase verbatim next to
their name. The site never paraphrases someone's research into a category. If a match looks wrong,
the quoted phrase is right there to judge it by.
Patterns are word-boundary regexes, case-insensitive, applied to each interest string separately.
Substring matching is not safe here -- it turns 'psychology of grace' into race research and
'distress tolerance' into stress research. Before adding a pattern, print what it catches across
the whole corpus and read the output.
'guides' cross-links a topic to the standing guides in data/hubs.json where the subject overlaps.
Rendered by scripts/render_topics.py, which build.py calls.
